name: Schedule Management
description: Generate and configure 52-week service schedule with special periods and week properties
features: View service availability system status by year
Edit individual week properties (cost, reward, type)

sub_modules.name: Schedule Overview
sub_modules.description: View generated schedule and availability status for the year

sub_modules.name: Generate Schedule
sub_modules.description: Create 52-week schedule with special periods configuration

sub_modules.name: Manage Weeks
sub_modules.description: Edit individual week properties and settings

use_cases: Setting up new academic year schedule
Defining summer, holiday, and conference periods
Adjusting point costs/rewards for specific weeks
api_endpoints: GET /api/admin/service-weeks?year={year} - Get all weeks for year
DELETE /api/admin/service-weeks/clear?year={year} - Clear all weeks for year

summer.impact: Higher point cost for requesting time off

week_properties.label: Week identifier (e.g., Week 1, Summer Week 3)
week_properties.cost_off: Points cost to request time off this week
week_properties.reward_work: Points reward for working this week

notes: Academic year starts first Tuesday of July
Weeks must be continuous with no gaps
Clearing weeks will affect availability requests and draft system
